description: Filed financial statements of one company, one row per fiscal year (newest first), with revenue, profit, assets, equity, liabilities and year-over-year trend. Amounts are EUR CENTS as integers (divide by 100 for euros). Use for trend and solvency questions; company_brief already carries the latest year.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the register (e.g. SK, CZ, AT, PL). Strongly recommended: registry numbers are NOT unique across countries (an SK and a CZ company can share the same 8-digit IČO), and without it the server picks one by tie-break.

ico.description: National registry identifier (SK/CZ IČO, AT Firmenbuch number, PL KRS/REGON, FR SIREN, …). Leading zeros are normalised server-side.

purpose.description: Legal purpose for natural-person (FO) data, attested by the account holder. Only needed when the API key has full FO access; must be one of the purposes licensed on the key. Never guess it — ask the user if it is not known.

name: get_financials

data.description: Per-year financial statements and trend summary.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id (quote it in support requests), duration_ms, cached.

title: Financial statements by year
